name: fld_pow_char_eq_self_iff_natCast
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] (x : K) : x ^ p = x ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x = (n : K)
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] (x : K), x ^ p = x ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x = (n : K)
informal: In any field of characteristic p the fixed points of Frobenius are exactly the prime field: x^p = x iff x is the image of a natural number — (←) Fermat's little theorem in ZMod p pushed along the cast; (→) X^p - X has at most p roots in K and the p distinct elements 0, 1, …, p-1 are roots, so they are all the roots.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP K p] (x : K), x ^ p = x ↔ ∃ n, x = ↑n
